name: docs_read_page
description: Read one Siemens documentation page as Markdown, with a header naming the publication, version, path and source reference. mode='outline' lists numbered headings with sizes; section takes an outline number or heading text (e.g. 'Example', which also matches 'Example: ...') and returns only those sections; mode='code' returns only code blocks under their headings. Long results end with the exact arguments to fetch the next part. Pass a compact reference (<prefix>:<mapId> or <prefix>:<mapId>/<contentId>; prefixes tia=docs.tia.siemens.cloud, iox=docs.industrial-operations-x.siemens.cloud) or a reader URL copied from a tool result or the browser. Results use compact references by default; set reference_format='url' for reader URLs.

url.description: Page reference or reader URL. Pass a compact reference (<prefix>:<mapId> or <prefix>:<mapId>/<contentId>; prefixes tia=docs.tia.siemens.cloud, iox=docs.industrial-operations-x.siemens.cloud) or a reader URL copied from a tool result or the browser.

section.description: Optional outline number (e.g. '3') or heading text from mode='outline'.

offset.description: Character offset to continue a long result; use the value the previous part gives.

reference_format.description: 'compact' (default) for short references or 'url' for full reader URLs.
